hostname ix-p01
!
ip route default 203.0.113.14
ip route 198.51.100.128/25 Tunnel0.0
ip route 203.0.113.128/25 Tunnel1.0
!
ip access-list sec-sample-a permit ip src 192.0.2.0/25 dest 198.51.100.0/25
ip access-list sec-sample-a permit ip src 192.0.2.0/25 dest 198.51.100.200/32
ip access-list sec-sample-any permit ip src any dest any
!
ikev2 authentication psk id ipv4 203.0.113.9 key char dummy-psk-sample-b
ikev2 authentication psk id ipv4 203.0.113.30 key char dummy-psk-sample-b
!
ike proposal ike-prop-sample-1 encryption aes-256 hash sha2-256 group 2048-bit
ike proposal ike-prop-sample-2 encryption aes hash sha group 1024-bit
ike policy ike-sample-a peer 203.0.113.20 key dummy-psk-sample-a ike-prop-sample-1,ike-prop-sample-2
ike policy ike-sample-c peer 203.0.113.40 key dummy-psk-sample-c ike-prop-sample-1,ike-prop-sample-2
!
ipsec autokey-proposal ipsec-prop-sample-1 esp-aes-256 esp-sha
ipsec autokey-proposal ipsec-prop-sample-2 esp-aes esp-sha
ipsec autokey-map ipsec-sample-a sec-sample-a peer 203.0.113.20 pfs 2048-bit ipsec-prop-sample-1,ipsec-prop-sample-2
ipsec autokey-map ipsec-sample-c sec-sample-any peer 203.0.113.40 ipsec-prop-sample-1
ipsec local-id ipsec-sample-c 192.0.2.0/25
ipsec remote-id ipsec-sample-c 203.0.113.128/25
!
ikev2 profile ikev2-sample-b
  child-proposal enc aes-cbc-256 aes-cbc-128
  child-proposal integrity sha1
  local-authentication psk
  local-ts ipv4 address 192.0.2.0/25
  remote-ts ipv4 address 198.51.100.128/25
  sa-proposal dh 2048-bit 1536-bit
  sa-proposal enc aes-cbc-256 aes-cbc-128
  sa-proposal integrity sha2-256 sha1
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample-wan
  ip address 203.0.113.9/29
  ipsec policy tunnel ipsec-sample-a out
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample-lan
  ip address 192.0.2.1/25
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel0.0
  tunnel mode ipsec-ikev2
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet1.0
  ikev2 binding ikev2-sample-b
  ikev2 peer 203.0.113.30 authentication psk
  ikev2 source-address GigaEthernet0.0
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel1.0
  tunnel mode ipsec
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet1.0
  ipsec policy tunnel ipsec-sample-c out
  no shutdown
